s_a11y.text: Every artboard root carries data-density="compact" (44 px rows, owner decision); the admin app ships light only for release 1.0 (owner decision), from the design system's tokens.css. 200% zoom boards are 720 CSS px (1440 screen); the SideNav collapses into a drawer behind Open navigation, in the AppBar's actions (component gap: AppBar has no leading slot). The drawer is Proposed component: NavDrawer (shadcn Sheet, side left; the design system Sheet only opens at inline-end): Radix Dialog traps focus inside it, Escape, Close or the overlay closes it and focus returns to Open navigation. At 720 and 320 px an in-page panel takes the whole content area, with Back to the list. Reflowed zoom boards may scroll (WCAG 1.4.10); the fit-the-viewport rule is for the desktop page. Tables keep their columns and scroll sideways in their own frame. Skip to table is rendered only when the table is.

s_accept.text:
Invitee flow, 2 steps: password, then two-step sign-in. Owner decision: no recovery codes at launch; a lost authenticator is reset only after a super admin calls the person back on the phone number on file and matches two account details; until the reset API exists, the platform on-call engineer does the reset (see the sign-in code step and the staff detail). Needs API: the invitation-scoped enrolment stops returning recovery_codes (the contract still returns 10). The enrolment returns provisioning_uri (QR, or Add to authenticator app on a phone). Setting up doesn't sign you in. Error codes appear only in annotations, never in the copy.

Needs API: invitation acceptance (token lookup with email, role, inviter and invitation_expires_at; set password; expired and used errors); invitation-scoped TOTP enrolment and verification, authorised by the invite token; does setting the password consume the token, and how long the link stays valid for step 2; retry-after on the lock; resend invite.

Phone boards: the invite email is often opened on a phone, where a QR code on the same screen can't be scanned, so step 2 leads with Add to authenticator app (provisioning_uri) and the key.

Go to sign in (Account ready, Invite already used) opens First sign-in: work email pre-filled from the invite lookup.

s_detail.text:
Detail panel: built from the loaded row until getStaffUser exists. One place for role and status (header badge + role). Every account-changing action is still Needs API, so the panel gives a working path instead:

Remove access now (someone left): a named platform on-call person and phone (owner names them before launch), the account ID with Copy ID, and the runbook linked from issue 66. When deactivate + end sessions exists, this becomes one confirmed action.

Reset two-step sign-in (owner: no recovery codes; only a super admin resets a password or authenticator by hand): the same on-call path. Call the person back on the phone number on file and match two account details (owner decision, round 2; a staff phone number is Needs API), call the on-call engineer with the account ID, tell them how you confirmed it (it goes in the audit log), stay on the call until they confirm. The form with a note, a confirmation tick and a Reset button, and its done state, sit below the row as Needs API, draw-ahead. It ends their sessions and they enrol again at next sign-in. Nobody resets their own.

Invited accounts: Cancel this invite (not Remove access): the invitee has no password and no sessions, so the panel says the link in their email works until it expires, and the on-call engineer deactivates the account so the link stops working. Needs API: cancel an invite; invitation_expires_at.

Deactivated accounts point to Invite this email again. Own account points to Your account (change password, sign out everywhere); My sessions is a later version. Support agents get 403 for any staff URL. Dates in the panel are full (weekday, date, time, time zone).

s_invite.text:
Invite. Focus opens on Full name; server errors move focus to the first bad field. The form opens in the in-page panel beside the list (no modal); Cancel or Close collapses it and returns focus to Invite staff. "No invite was sent" only after a definite 4xx (409, 422, 403, 401). Timeout, 5xx or a dropped connection say "We couldn't confirm the invite was sent": the retry reuses the same Idempotency-Key, so it can't create a second invite or email.

409 names the person from the loaded list and links to their account; when the matching account isn't loaded, it says only "This email already belongs to a staff account" (Needs API: 409 details with the existing staff id). The form keeps its values if they come back through Invite staff. Error codes stay in annotations, never in the copy.

403 mid-session: Continue re-fetches the role and routes: Admin to the read-only Staff list, Support agent to Live alerts.

401 with unsent details: values kept on this device (sessionStorage) and restored after sign-in.

Needs API: createStaffUser to say reactivated vs created.

s_shell.text:
Shell. IA per audit/admin.md §4.0: Review (Halal certificates first, Menu reviews at launch), Operate (Orders, Refunds & disputes, Live alerts), Platform (Staff, Your account; My sessions is a later version); footer What's new and System status. Support agents see Halal certificates and Restaurant applications marked view only, no Rider applications and no Staff.

Desktop layout (owner, all admin canvases): the page never scrolls and fits 1440 x 900. Long lists scroll inside their own region (LyteNyte Grid virtualises rows). Nothing working opens over the page: detail opens in an in-page panel beside the list (Proposed component: DetailPanel, shadcn Resizable + ScrollArea); System status splits into two panes (Proposed component: SplitPane). Both resize with shadcn ResizableHandle withHandle: a focusable separator with a 44 px hit area, Left and Right arrow keys, and the standard focus ring. Opening a panel collapses the navigation to its 80 px rail; Expand navigation brings it back and the panel narrows. Blocking system states (your session ended) keep the design system's Modal: nothing else on the page can work.

SideNav, KeyValueList, StatCard and FileDrop are approved for the design system (owner); SideNav and KeyValueList are drawn here from their parts until they're built. Chrome uses roles only: surface-chrome, text-on-accent, focus-ring-on-accent. Needs tokens: text-on-chrome-secondary, surface-chrome-selected, border-on-chrome. Sign out is a component gap (Button variant on-chrome).

Solar glyphs to add to the design system (dashed squares; never a shield or check-badge): document-text (Halal certificates), shop, bicycling, buildings, wallet-money, stars, server, logout. Until they exist, the collapsed rail shows a short text label under every item. Halal certificates has no count: Needs API: certificate queue depth in admin.queue_depth, and halal alert kinds.

Design system: this canvas uses the system's current tokens.css (1790605103-3266) with no local overrides. Known system issue, left as is: a primary Button's focus flips to a white ring on an orange gap (.hg-on-brand), 1.04:1 against the cream page (see Keyboard focus states).

s_staff.text:
Staff. Contract: listStaff (ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN; Limit + Cursor), createStaffUser (SUPER_ADMIN, Idempotency-Key, 409). Emails shown in full to super admins; admins see name, role and status only (settled). Rows are one tab stop; Enter or click opens the account in the in-page panel; closing it returns focus to the row. Dates: short in cells (no year for this year), full date, time and time zone in a tooltip and in the panel (owner).

What each role can do is a disclosure, closed by default, so the list keeps the height. Owner decisions in its copy: a goodwill refund above CAD 50.00 needs a second admin; after acceptance, cancelling needs no support case; menu items an admin adds are approved on creation and audited. No warning above 25 active staff at launch (owner), so that board is gone.

Needs API: change role, suspend, restore, deactivate, resend invite, reset two-step sign-in, sign out someone's sessions; StaffUser.invitation_expires_at; getStaffUser by id; search, sort and filter on listStaff; count of active staff; GET /admin/me/permissions; per-role StaffUser projection for ADMIN; confirm StaffUser.id == Principal.account_id (You badge).

Fewer than two active super admins shows a warning on the list, only when has_more=false. ACTIVE without two-step sign-in: warning badge "Not set up" (tint only), never red.
